scope: Actual residual RMSNorm component alignment only; not full-model numerical or answer acceptance.
captured_inputs: Two fixed prefixes, eight PP0 CP ranks, layer0.post_attention_layernorm and layer1.input_layernorm; only valid token rows compared.
native_provider: Installed native RMSNorm.forward_hip -> lightop.op.fused_add_rms_norm_opt; all32 native-input replays exactly reconstruct actual native outputs.
root_cause: Triton accumulated variance from FP32 input+residual but stored BF16 residual in pass1 and reloaded it for the normalization numerator. Torch fallback also prematurely rounded the residual sum.
fix: Retain original input/residual through variance pass; recompute FP32 sum in pass2 and round only final output and stored residual. Torch fallback likewise normalizes FP32 sum.
recipe: Existing HCU_FUSED_ADD_RMS_IMPL=lightop explicitly selected for GLM; generic default remains triton.
reference_matrix: BF16/FP16/FP32, hidden6144/8193, ordinary/Gemma variants; FP32 reference metrics recorded, not bitwise acceptance for differing reduction orders.
